composition: horizontal trio of planes on muted ground
description: Multiple warplane silhouettes rendered in black line drawing occupy a yellow-and-white ground, arranged in overhead perspective across the horizontal field. Scattered compact discs, concentric target circles, photographic strips, and the hand-lettered phrase "THE KING OF" populate the surrounding collaged surface alongside small figure groups and vertical orange rectangles.
title: Untitled (Three Planes, Yellow)
